description: This file contains the implementation of the PdfCrossReferenceStream class within the PdfSharp library. It models a PDF cross-reference stream, including its entries, associated keys, and the relevant metadata. It extends functionality from PdfTrailer to handle specific cross-reference stream data in a PDF document.

classes.name: PdfCrossReferenceStream
classes.description: Represents a PDF cross-reference stream, maintaining a list of entries and associated metadata, extending PdfTrailer.

classes.name: PdfCrossReferenceStream.CrossReferenceStreamEntry
classes.description: Struct representing a single cross-reference stream entry with fields for type, size, and object number or index.

classes.name: PdfCrossReferenceStream.Keys
classes.description: Defines the set of keys specific to the cross-reference stream dictionary, including mandatory and optional entries.

methods.name: PdfCrossReferenceStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new cross-reference stream instance for a given PdfDocument.
